composites.name: maboss_toggle_switch
composites.description: A two-node MaBoSS Boolean network (A activated by B, B repressed by A), advanced one interval at a time from one sampled joint state; emits each node's state and ensemble on-probability.

k_up.description: Rate at which A switches on when B is on

seed.description: Base seed (MaBoSS and the joint-state sampler)
